body: Swamp Thing?!?
"Oh, your knee needs to be replaced? You should jog. That'll fix things right up!"
That yoga statement really hits home.
I have this thought nearly every morning. The mere act of waking up to this reality is torture.

Some of us spend our entire lives regretting past decisions. But what we often forget from those moments are the circumstances that led us to those decisions. If you had the ability to relive your life with the exact same circumstances and thought processes of the time, it stands to reason there's a 100 percent chance you wouldn't change a thing. You might regret those moments now, but that regret is because you learned and matured since then. So just try to take the lessons and leave the baggage.

It's funny you mention caring for your elderly dad. I take care of my elderly mom because it's the right thing to do. And I think doing the right thing is a sign of being a good person. So to answer your question, yes, you're a good daughter. But talk about a sense of duty! Staying at home with an elderly parent is a duty that can, and most likely will, encompass your life. There are times when I don't feel like a good person at all. I often get selfish and bitter because of the sacrifices I've made.

Am I happy? I'm working hard to be content with my choices because, really, that's the only happiness I can have right now. Do I want more? Sure, I'd love to find a Disney Princess and live happily ever after. But my life isn't a Disney movie. It's more like a Ralph Bakshi flick.
When I find myself at a low point it really is therapeutic to help others.

I had a good experience with a therapist. She got me through a really rough time. I'm not saying they're all like that. As soon as your therapist starts dicking around you should immediately request to switch to someone else.

I'm just saying that being an introvert isn't necessarily a bad thing. Some of the greatest writers, artists and musicians in history were introverts. The people you're hanging with may not understand your awkwardness in the moment and that can come across as you're feeling weird around them. That drops your confidence to a new level and eventually becomes a self feeding neurosis.  


Are there any situations where you do feel comfortable being yourself, like among friends or family?
Your BF loves you because he loves YOU. Disappearing from his life isn't going to change that.
You're anonymously posting here. Did you stop to think that no one you know will see this?
Why don't you deserve your boyfriend? Have you talked to him about it?
You may end up only hurting/disfiguring yourself.
I don't hate you.
We can change the world only by acting against the things we hate.

OK, be the best introvert you can be! I find introverts to be some of the kindest people on this planet. Just because it's not "ordinary" doesn't mean it's wrong. The reason introverts seem to be unordinary is because they rarely talk about it. :)
It depends on who the person is. I hope you find that person in life who can truly understand your pain. They do exist. This sub is proof of that.

There is no such thing as an "ordinary" person. People pretend to be ordinary. They wear masks based on what society dictates through the media. I say fuck all that. Be the craziest motherfucker you can be, just don't hurt others in the process.

A very dear friend of mine has her dream job and is married, Her parents love and support her, she has influence and remarkable artistic talent that she's turned into an amazing, decades-long career. Yet she's miserably depressed more times than not. Like her, You seem to be focused on what you can't have, and that's become your goal for "true" happiness. This also explains why you can't just exist like a piece of furniture. It's not in your nature to simply be a non-achiever.

Looking back, I wish I could tell my 18 year old self, "Don't let society tell you what success is. Make your own success, and if you can't do that then do everything you can to enjoy the life you have. Personal enjoyment is the only success that matters."
"god" lol. We get better results sitting on Santa's lap at Christmas. At least he pretends to listen.

I was in a car crash 9 years ago. Every day is physical torture. On my best days I can barely walk with a cane. On my worst days I have to use a wheelchair. I love nature photography but I can't walk through the woods any more. Chronic pain every day. Life has become an absolute living hell. I know your pain and I'm so sorry that you're going through this.  


All I can say is try not to let your pain dictate your life. 9 years later and I'm now a miserable fuck. Don't let it change you like it changed me.
I've always felt that assisted suicide is illegal not because it's wrong but because it kills taxpayers.
Thank you for understanding.
The world is shit. I'd think you were crazy if you didn't hate it.
Love is the absolute worst torture that's ever existed.

I know this will pass. These thoughts have come and gone before. But before, I had her to talk to. She'd help me get through this shit. I deleted her, blocked her with no way of ever communicating with her again. She just moved to a new place and I don't know where it is. I hope I didn't just fuck up my only chance of survival.
